sourceQuote: Two blank pages of the passport ( For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.)
targetQuote: 护照中的两页空白页（主管机关必须确保护照中至少有两页空白页，以便中国大使馆贴签证纸、移民部门贴居留许可纸。）
